# paradigm-edges-turbovec

> **Paradigm-Edges + TurboQuant edge memory.** Index discovered edges so future probing finds similar past patterns.

## Quick Start

```python
from paradigm_edges_turbovec import EdgeMemoryIndex

mem = EdgeMemoryIndex(dim=384, n_bits=4)

mem.add_edge(
    paradigm='math',
    prompt='What is 17 * 23?',
    edge_type='format_violation',
    severity=4.5,
    description='No standard column multiplication',
    evidence='17 × (20 + 3)',
    model='deepseek',
)

results = mem.find_similar_edges('What is 12 * 34?', k=3)
```
